team.joinHelp: Ask the host for the 5-character code, then pick a team name.
team.answerIn: In: “{answer}”. You can change it until the host reveals.
team.sitTight: Sit tight. The host will start the first question from the desk.
team.waitingForHost: Waiting for the host to start the quiz.
team.noConnection: No connection, your answer was not saved
team.lastRound: That was the last round. The final scores are on their way.
team.answersIn: Answers are in. The host is checking them.

tv.checkCode: Check the code on the host desk.

desk.missingTotals: No round {round} total for {names}. They score 0 for it unless you type one.

phoneTeamsAnswered.one: {answered} of {count} phone teams have answered this one.
phoneTeamsAnswered.other: {answered} of {count} phone teams have answered this one.

desk.scoreboardShowing: Showing on the TV and the phones.
desk.scoreboardPrivate: Only you can see this until you show it.
desk.roundsCount: Rounds count once every answer in them is revealed.
desk.closeBody: Teams can't change their answers after this. You check the marks next.
desk.finishBody: The final scoreboard goes up on every screen. This cannot be undone.
desk.lobbyHelp: Teams join on their phones with the code. Tables playing on paper: add them by name.

revealedOf.one: {revealed} of {count} answers revealed. Marked automatically. Tap a mark to change it. The room sees nothing here.
revealedOf.other: {revealed} of {count} answers revealed. Marked automatically. Tap a mark to change it. The room sees nothing here.

desk.markedRight: {team}, {question}: {answer}, marked right. Tap to mark wrong.
desk.markedWrong: {team}, {question}: {answer}, marked wrong. Tap to mark right.
desk.onPaper: On paper: {names}. Type their round totals below.
desk.totalsHelp: Type a total for a paper team, for sheets the tables swapped and marked, or to override a phone team's.
desk.tvHelp: What the room should see, and nothing more: no answers until you reveal them.
desk.extendNotMirror: On a laptop, use Extend, not Mirror. Cast a tab, not your screen, or the room will see the answers.
desk.lateTable: A table added now scores 0 for rounds already closed.
desk.hostLinkHelp: Keep this link to reopen the host desk on another device.
desk.endBody: Teams stop being able to answer and the scoreboard becomes final. The pack can be edited again afterwards. This cannot be undone.
desk.finishedEarly: Finished early? Ending the game unlocks the pack for editing.
desk.keyRejected: This browser's host key was rejected for this session.
desk.lostConnection: Lost connection to the session. Retrying…
desk.keyNeededHelp: This browser doesn't have host access for session {code}. If you started this session here, try reopening it from the pack editor. Otherwise paste the host key you were given when the session was created.
desk.shareCode: Share the code. Start when everyone is in. Late joiners can still arrive during the lobby.
desk.moveDevices: Best to keep this browser open. If you do move devices, sign in there and open the host link below. Anyone else will be asked for this session's host key.
desk.answerHidden: Answer stays hidden until you reveal.
desk.thatsTheNight: That’s the night. Final standings are on the right. Thanks for hosting.
desk.finishedEarlyOrMistake: Finished early, or opened this session by mistake? Ending the game unlocks the pack for editing.

print.title: Print layout
print.lectern: {rounds} · keep this copy at the lectern
print.question: Question
print.cueWelcome: Welcome everyone, introduce tonight’s quiz, and remind teams how scoring works.
print.cueRound: Announce the round title and category. Give teams a moment to ready their sheets.
print.cueAnswers: Read the answers, then confirm scores on the host dashboard before moving on.
print.cueFinal: Announce final scores and thank everyone for playing.

notFound.heading: That page isn't on the board.
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the session it pointed at has finished. Join codes are five characters and are entered on the join page, not typed into the address bar.

signIn.description: Sign in to write, print and run your quiz packs.
signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.intro: Your packs, your plan and your free allowance live on your account — not in this browser. Signing in on any device brings all three with you.
signIn.teamsNote: Running a quiz as a team? You don't need an account — just the join code from your host.
signIn.codeOnItsWay: A six-digit code is on its way to {email}. Type it in below — or open the link in the same email and press the button there. Either works once, and both expire in 15 minutes.
signIn.nothingYet: Nothing after a minute or two? Check spam, then {retry}.
signIn.inAppNotice: You're in an in-app browser. Google may block sign-in here — use the email code below, or open this page in your browser.
signIn.googleRefusesHint: Opened this from LinkedIn or another app? If Google won't let you in, use the email code below.
signIn.noPassword: No password to remember, and none for us to lose.

googleErrors.unable_to_create_user: Something went wrong setting up your account. Please try again.
googleErrors.state_mismatch: That Google sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
googleErrors.fallback: That sign-in didn't complete. Try again below.

confirm.heading: Confirm sign-in
confirm.notYou: Not you? Close this page — nothing has happened yet. Need a fresh code? {startAgain}.
confirm.linkBroken: That link is missing the part that signs you in — some mail clients cut long links in half. Type the six-digit code from the same email instead.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.sendFailed: Couldn't send that code. Check the address and try again.
errors.googleFailed: Couldn't start Google sign-in. Please try again, or use the email code below.
errors.fallback: Couldn't sign you in with that. Ask for a fresh one and try again.

typed.INVALID_OTP: That code didn't match. Check the six digits and try again.
typed.OTP_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Codes last 15 minutes — ask for a fresh one.
typed.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes for that one. Ask for a fresh one.

fromLink.INVALID_OTP: That sign-in link no longer works. Links work once and last 15 minutes — ask for a fresh one.
fromLink.OTP_EXPIRED: That sign-in link has expired. Links last 15 minutes — ask for a fresh one.
fromLink.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes for that one. Ask for a fresh one.

errors.codesPaused: Email codes are paused until tomorrow — please use Google sign-in.
errors.tooManyForAddress: Too many codes sent to that address. Wait an hour, or use Google sign-in.
errors.tooManyFromHere: Too many codes requested from this network. Try again later, or use Google sign-in.
errors.emailTooLong: That email address is too long — addresses can be at most 254 characters. Check it and try again.

email.subject: {code} is your TriviaFoundry sign-in code
email.text:
Your TriviaFoundry sign-in code is {code}

Type it into the sign-in page you started on — that works even if you
are reading this on a different device.

Or open this link and press the button there to sign in:

{url}

The code works once and expires in 15 minutes.
If you didn't ask to sign in, you can ignore this email — nobody can
sign in as you without the code above.
email.typeIt: Type it into the sign-in page you started on — that works even if you are reading this on a different device.
email.orOpen: Or open this link and press the button there to sign in:
email.expires: The code works once and expires in 15 minutes.
email.ignore: If you didn't ask to sign in, you can ignore this email — nobody can sign in as you without the code above.

wizard.example: A Friday-night pub quiz: four rounds covering 90s music, UK geography, movie quotes, and a general knowledge closer. Keep answers short and pub-friendly.
wizard.waitingLine: Writing and fact-checking your pack. This usually takes up to about a minute. Keep this tab open.
wizard.stillWorking: Still working, taking longer than usual.
wizard.heading: Generate a quiz pack
wizard.intro: Tell the wizard what kind of night you are running. It will draft rounds, questions, answers, and points you can edit next.
wizard.proLifted: You are on Pro: the {limit}-pack limit is lifted. {manage}
wizard.freeUsed: {used}/{limit} free packs used in the last 30 days
wizard.paymentSlow: Payment received. Switching Pro on is taking longer than usual; reload this page in a minute.
wizard.declined: The question generator wouldn’t write this brief.
wizard.declinedHint: Edit the brief above and generate again.
wizard.upgradeLine: {upgrade} to lift the {limit}-pack limit, or use the demo pack.
wizard.failedStatus: Generation failed (server returned status {status}). Please try again.
wizard.demoFailed: Could not create the demo pack

packs.heading: Quiz packs
packs.intro: Edit questions, preview print sheets, then start a live session.
packs.liveGamesNote: Open the host desk on this device — you don't need the host key for a game you started. A game still running here also stops its pack being restructured.
packs.noneHint: Generate one from a brief, or seed the demo pack.

editor.startExplainer: {start} opens your host screen with a five-character code teams enter at {url}. {howTo}
editor.howTo: How to run a quiz night
editor.readOnly: This is a shared pack, so it's read-only here. Export JSON, then import it from the packs list to get your own editable copy.
editor.unchecked: This pack wasn't checked — give it an extra careful read before the night.
